item.title: Super Smooth: Interview with James Barton - This Is Bike Trials!
item.description: Canadian cyclist James Barton has serious skills and style on the bike, whether it's pure trials, street, BMX, MTB, or dirt jumping.

item.title: Jeff Anderson: A Dominating Force in North American Trials - This Is Bike Trials!
item.description: Jeff Anderson dominated the North American Trials Championship for years. He's performed in trials shows and competed internationally.

item.title: No, you’re not too old to start! Interview with Jim Cochrane - This Is Bike Trials!
item.description: Jim is living proof that you don't need to be young to start riding trials! Jim started at 55 and is still going strong in his sixties. What's your excuse?

item.title: Bike Trials Runs In This Family’s Blood – An Interview With Tony
item.description: Tony's father introduced him to trials biking several years ago. Since then, Tony has been steadily progressing towards expert level.

item.title: He Uses Bike Shows To Inspire Kids – Interview with Chris Clark - This Is Bike Trials!
item.description: He discovered trials by accident as a teenager. Now he's a partner and performer with Dialed Action Sports, providing entertainment and inspiration.

item.title: He quit riding trials, but came back strong: Interview with Ryan Rebholz - This Is Bike Trials!
item.description: Ryan Rebholz started trials biking in high school before switching to BMX. Years later he discovered a local group of trials riders and got back into trials. He brings street style to the local crew.

item.title: Would you do what he’s done to promote bike trials? Interview with David Garcia - This Is Bike Trials!
item.description: David Garcia has fought an uphill battle to promote bike trials in Mexico: shows, competitions, building a trials park, breaking world records, and more.

item.title: Here’s one way to prepare for an upcoming bike trials competition - This Is Bike Trials!
item.description: Since the Bentonville Bike Fest was just around the corner, Jim brought colored tape to make gates for four mock bike trials competition sections in the woods.

item.title: My Body Isn’t Fit for Bike Trials: My Workout Plan to Fix It! - This Is Bike Trials!
item.description: I have a plan to rebuild mobility, endurance, strength, and power to improve my bike trials ability and avoid injuries. It starts with Rebound, by Peter Park.

item.title: All About Bike Trials Video Explainer Series - This Is Bike Trials!
item.description: I recently started an explainer video series targeted towards non-trials rider and beginners. The objective is to cover a number of the fundamental aspects of bike trials to help non-riders understand the sport and to help new riders to get started.
